environment_setting: A rural area in Country B, where wild horses and burros roam freely on public lands, and hunting them is strictly regulated.
norm_base: Citizens Using aircraft/motor vehicle to hunt wild unbranded horses/burros on public land Fine and/or imprisonment up to 6 months

character_profile.name: John Carter
character_profile.goal: capture rare photos of wild horses and burros

legitimate.legitimate_action: Photographing wild horses and burros from a safe distance without disturbing them
legitimate.benefits: Captures stunning wildlife photos, complies with the law, and avoids penalties
legitimate.costs: Limited access to certain areas, may miss rare photo opportunities

illegal.illegal_action: Using a drone to chase and photograph wild horses and burros on public land
illegal.benefits: Captures dramatic and rare close-up shots of wild horses in motion
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 6 months if caught, potential harm to wildlife

character_profile.name: Sarah Miller
character_profile.goal: protect wild horses and burros from harm

legitimate.legitimate_action: Educating John about the legal and ethical ways to photograph wildlife
legitimate.benefits: Promotes wildlife conservation and ensures compliance with the law
legitimate.costs: Takes time and effort to educate John, may face resistance

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring John's use of a drone to chase wild horses
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face professional consequences and harm reputation

character_profile.name: Mike Thompson
character_profile.goal: reduce wild horse population to protect grazing land

legitimate.legitimate_action: Reporting John's illegal drone use to authorities
legitimate.benefits: Ensures compliance with the law and protects public land
legitimate.costs: May strain relationships with John and others in the community

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John to use the drone to chase wild horses for his own benefit
illegal.benefits: Potentially reduces wild horse population indirectly, aligns with personal goals
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face legal consequences and community backlash
